g.text: Proposed research design • Planning assumptions, not empirical effect estimates
Baseline 20% • Two-sided α=.05 • Power 80% • Attrition 15% • Cluster illustration: 20 observed/office, ICC .05
Prospective identification needs: defined population, valid assignment/comparison, consistent outcomes, follow-up, and an interference plan.
Power calculations do not repair selection bias. Causal arrows are assumptions. Future confirmatory tests require an independent evaluation dataset.
